source_config.description: Blue-base horizontal carriage: upper armor, green lamp, connected brackets and carriage hardware. Lower sloped armor and rail-fastening screws remain fixed. Selection is tied to the supplied mesh topology and source hashes; user confirmed the moving assembly. Guide travel is derived from the two rail components and the full moving assembly footprint.

dynamics_estimate.note: Simulation demonstration estimates; no measured motor, friction, mass or inertia identification.

note: Only lens repair patches are replaced by the audited closed lens hulls. All other repairs and terrain closures/heightfields are retained.
